name: St. Augustine
seo_title: St. Augustine golf cart map and LSV map
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in St. Augustine?
answer_short: Street-legal LSVs yes, on roads posted 35 mph or less. Plain golf carts only on streets a city or county has designated and signed, and St. Augustine Beach says traditional golf carts may not use its public streets. US 1, SR 312, SR 207 and SR 16 stay red on the map.

golf_cart.notes: No official street list found; the map shows only cart paths and roads mapped as designated for carts

rules.rule: Registered, insured LSVs only on streets posted 35 mph or less; may cross a faster road at an intersection
Plain golf carts only on roads a county or city has designated for carts and signed
Traditional golf carts may not be operated on public streets. LSVs must be registered and insured, with a licensed driver, on streets 35 mph and under

banned_roads.name: US 1 (Ponce de Leon Blvd)
banned_roads.rule: State road; the map keeps it red for LSVs and golf carts

banned_roads.name: SR 312, SR 207 and SR 16
banned_roads.rule: State roads; the map keeps them red for LSVs and golf carts

banned_roads.name: A1A where posted over 35 mph
banned_roads.rule: No LSVs; plain golf carts banned on St. Augustine Beach streets

faq.q: Can I drive an LSV across the Bridge of Lions?
faq.a: Yes, if it is a registered, street-legal LSV. The Bridge of Lions is posted 30 mph in our data, under the 35 mph LSV limit. A plain golf cart is not allowed unless the road is designated for carts, and the map shows it in red for golf carts.

faq.q: Can I drive a regular golf cart in St. Augustine Beach?
faq.a: No. The City of St. Augustine Beach says traditional golf carts may not be operated on public streets. Street-legal LSVs may use streets posted 35 mph and under.

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in St. Augustine?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less (F.S. 316.2122). The map keeps US 1, SR 312, SR 207, SR 16 and faster stretches of A1A red; you may cross a faster road at an intersection. Posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a plain golf cart in downtown St. Augustine?
faq.a: Only on streets the city or county has designated and signed for golf carts (F.S. 316.212). We have not found an official city or county street list, so the map shows plain golf carts only on cart paths and the few roads mapped as designated for carts.
